notes.title: Staffer Retro joins at Busan Indie Connect Festival in Korea!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="tyntkb0RXB4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Play the Staffer Retro demo at BIC 2025 and grab a chance to get exclusive merch![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We are joining Busan Indie Connect Festival 2025![/p][p]During the event, you can download a demo build of Staffer Retro—currently in development—via the BIC exhibition hall and the official BIC website.
